gatoh.model.ABModel.add_graphs

ABModel.add_graphs(graphs: list[Graph] | list[str], names: list[str], rw_params: list[tuple[float, float]]) → GraphSet[source]

Add new Graphs to the Model’s GraphSet.

Parameters:

  • graphs (list[Graph] | list[str]) – Graph objects or filepaths to stored GraphML objects.

  • names (list[str]) – The corresponding social hierarchy names to give to the Graphs.

  • rw_params (list[tuple[float, float]]) – The (mean, variance) to assign to the hierarchy when determining normal distributions for random walk dynamic relationships.

Returns:

The model’s newly updated graph set.

Return type:

GraphSet
